skill.name: documentation
skill.description: Guides AI assistants to create clear Markdown documents, including plans, proposals, guides, specifications, notes, and READMEs.
skill.summary: Create readable Markdown documents with structure, tone guidance, and optional diagram support.
skill.author: BfdCampos

content.value_statement: Teams need readable documents that capture plans, proposals, designs, and guides without losing structure. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create concise Markdown files.
actual_capabilities: Guides assistants to save long-form documents as Markdown files.
Encourages headers, bullets, lists, and tables for readable structure.
Recommends code blocks for commands and configuration examples.
Suggests Mermaid diagrams for architectures, flows, and relationships.
Adapts tone for technical docs, proposals, brainstorms, and plans.
Gives practical guidance on when emojis help or distract.
limitations: Does not include detailed templates for every document type.
Does not verify technical facts, links, or diagram accuracy.
Does not create diagrams directly; it recommends Mermaid when helpful.
Requires clear user goals and source material for accurate output.

use_cases.title: Write Project READMEs
use_cases.description: Create a clear README with setup notes, usage guidance, and organized sections.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Plans
use_cases.description: Turn goals, constraints, and decisions into a readable planning document.

use_cases.title: Document Architecture Decisions
use_cases.description: Explain systems, tradeoffs, and relationships with concise prose and optional diagrams.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Guide
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Markdown guide for this topic. Use clear headers, short paragraphs, and practical next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Proposal
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a proposal from these notes. Include the problem, goals, options, recommendation, risks, and next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Document a System Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a system design document. Cover context, architecture, data flow, tradeoffs, open questions, and diagram opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Documentation Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan and write a small documentation set for this project. Separate overview, setup, operations, and decision records.

output_examples.input: Create a README for a command line tool.
output_examples.output: A Markdown README with overview, installation, usage, configuration, troubleshooting, and contribution sections.

output_examples.input: Turn meeting notes into a project plan.
output_examples.output: A Markdown plan with goals, scope, milestones, owners, risks, decisions, and next steps.

output_examples.input: Explain a service architecture for new engineers.
output_examples.output: A concise architecture guide with components, data flow, key tradeoffs, and suggested Mermaid diagram sections.

best_practices: Provide the audience, purpose, source notes, and required file name.
Ask for diagrams only when relationships or flows need visual support.
Review the final document for technical accuracy before publishing.
anti_patterns: Requesting a long document without audience or purpose.
Using the skill as a source of verified facts without references.
Forcing emojis or diagrams into formal documents where they distract.

faq.question: Does this skill create files?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides assistants to save long-form documents as Markdown files instead of printing them in full.

faq.question: Is it only for technical documentation?
faq.answer: No. It also supports proposals, plans, notes, brainstorms, guides, specifications, and READMEs.

faq.question: Does it require Mermaid diagrams?
faq.answer: No. It recommends Mermaid only when architecture, flows, or relationships benefit from a visual explanation.

faq.question: Does it verify facts?
faq.answer: No. Users should provide source material and review claims before publishing the document.

faq.question: Can it adapt tone?
faq.answer: Yes. It gives tone guidance for technical docs, proposals, brainstorms, and plans.

faq.question: Which tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
